task: The tests in this project fail. Find out why and fix it.

turn 1
  model asks:  run_tests {}
  model asks:  list_files {}
  tool result: --- FAIL: TestParse (0.00s) (5 lines)
  tool result: duration.go, duration_test.go

turn 2
  model asks:  read_file {"path": "duration.go"}
  model asks:  read_file {"path": "duration_test.go"}
  tool result: // Package duration parses durations suc... (44 lines)
  tool result: package duration (36 lines)

turn 3
  model asks:  edit_file
                 path: "duration.go"
                 old: "'m': time.Second,"
                 new: "'m': time.Minute,"
  model asks:  run_tests {}
  tool result: edited duration.go
  tool result: ok  	duration	0.002s

turn 4
  model says:  The tests now pass. The cause was a typo in the unit table in
               duration.go: the 'm' (minute) entry mapped to time.Second. So
               "45m" parsed as 45 seconds, and "1h30m" parsed as 1h + 30
               seconds. I changed it to time.Minute.
